# Luxembourg FLIK Parcels

Luxembourg field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Administration des services techniques de l'agriculture. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lu/latest/lu.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lu/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2169; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, id, collection, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lu/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lu/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lu/collection.json
